name: Button
description: A versatile button component with multiple variants and sizes, built with class-variance-authority for flexible styling.
usage: Use the Button component for all clickable actions. Choose variants based on visual hierarchy and context.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child component with Slot

name: Badge
description: A small label component for displaying tags, statuses, or categories with customizable variants.
thumbnail: Badge component for labels and tags
usage: Use Badge to highlight tags, statuses, or categories. Use default variant for primary labels and outline for subtle tags.

name: Toggle
description: A toggle button component built on Radix UI that can be toggled on or off with accessible state management.
usage: Use Toggle for binary state changes like bold/italic text formatting, sound on/off, or view modes.

name: Toggle Group
description: A group of toggle buttons where only one can be selected at a time, built on Radix UI.
thumbnail: Toggle Group component for single selection
usage: Use ToggleGroup to create mutually exclusive button groups like view modes, text alignment, or option selection.

name: Sheet
description: A side panel component built on Radix UI Dialog that slides in from the edge with overlay support.
usage: Use Sheet for navigation menus, filters, or additional content that needs to be accessed without leaving the current view.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side the sheet slides from

name: Toast
description: A notification component that displays brief messages that automatically disappear after a timeout.
usage: Use Toast to display temporary notifications like success messages, errors, or informational alerts.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long to show the toast in ms
